Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Eerie Emblem
Abyss Tablet
--------
Item Level: 79
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Abysses to a Map
10 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Challenger's" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 13(10-15)% increased Effectiveness
{ Prefix Modifier "Abounding" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 19(15-20)% increased Monster Rarity
{ Suffix Modifier "of Treasures" (Tier: 1) }
Abyss Pits in Map are twice as likely to have Rewards — Unscalable Value
{ Suffix Modifier "of Shrines" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 79(70-100)% increased chance to contain Shrines
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
